previous_statement: Theta calculation: for any bounded operator T with ||T||<1/2, the registered power-series calculus gives sgn(T-I)=-I and hence theta(T-I)=(I+sgn(T-I))/2=0.
new_statement: Theta calculation: for any bounded operator T with ||T||<1/3, the registered power-series calculus gives sgn(T-I)=-I and hence theta(T-I)=(I+sgn(T-I))/2=0.
